verdict.rationale: Gumroad offers a public REST API for products, sales, subscribers and licenses, so asking about idempotency keys for safe retries is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions idempotency keys, retry safety or duplicate-charge prevention, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
